text.en: An old barrow, a knight, and a griffin. This looks like the start of a very unusual errand.
text.zh-CN: 一座古冢、一位骑士，还有一只狮鹫。这趟差事看来很不寻常。

text.en: If you've come for the sword, the griffin has already heard every excuse.
text.zh-CN: 若你是冲着古剑来的，狮鹫已经听过所有借口了。

text.en: Good thing I'm here for the company.
That's the first excuse it hasn't heard.
text.zh-CN: 这倒是它头一回听到的借口。

text.en: King Arthur, how about traveling with us?
text.zh-CN: 亚瑟王，要不要和我们一起旅行？

text.en: Do you invite every stranger you meet?
text.zh-CN: 你遇到陌生人，都会这样邀请吗？

text.en: Only the ones with excellent references. Yours come with a castle.
text.zh-CN: 只邀请来头可靠的。你的来头，还附带一座城堡。

text.en: I'll take that as a compliment.
The Lady of the Lake entrusted me with a sword. I thought the hard part would be finding someone worthy to wield it.
text.zh-CN: 湖中仙女托付给我一把剑。我原以为，最难的是找到配得上它的人。

text.en: Then I became king. Everyone had a problem, and very few of them could be solved by hitting something.
text.zh-CN: 后来我成了国王。每个人都有难题，能靠砍点什么解决的却寥寥无几。

text.en: I come here when I need to think. The griffin is a splendid adviser. It has yet to suggest raising taxes.
text.zh-CN: 需要静一静时，我就来这里。狮鹫是位好顾问，至今还没劝我加过税。

text.en: I'll assume that means hello. Your manners are better than most guards'.
text.zh-CN: 我就当这是在问好了。你的礼貌，比大多数守卫强。

prompt.en: What will you say to Arthur?

description.en: A king, a sword, and an unfinished story.
description.zh-CN: 一位国王、一把古剑，还有未完的故事。
亚瑟身边警觉而寡言的旅伴。
